component.name: OpenBox Game Launcher
component.summary: Local-first Linux game library and launcher

description.p: OpenBox Game Launcher is an open-source game library manager and launcher for Linux. It combines Steam, Heroic, Lutris, ROM collections, and emulator workflows in one local catalog with advanced search, ordered playlists, metadata, artwork galleries, session tracking, backups, and launch profiles.
OpenBox Game Launcher is unrelated to the Openbox Linux window manager. The projects have different maintainers, codebases, and purposes.

Features include Big Box fullscreen browsing, Steam Game Mode guest support for handhelds, LaunchBox Games Database sync, advanced search, manual and filter playlists, context actions, configurable status badges, collection details, RetroAchievements integration, save and library backups, artwork galleries, plugin hooks, storefront import tools, custom fields, ESRB filters, list view, drag-and-drop import, bundled media packs, and an English-only interface with localization planned. LaunchBox Premium-equivalent workflows are included without a subscription.
Guided Setup Center, Activity drawer with durable operations, Launch Doctor preflight, additive v2 API, and 20k-scale performance gates.

Setup Center previews every import and enrichment step before commit. Activity shows long-running work with SSE progress and recovery. Launch Doctor explains launch readiness. x86_64 AppImage and Flatpak bundles ship without telemetry.
State decomposition, launch token centralization, accessible navigation tools menu, search index memoization, and security hardening.

Decomposes webapp_state into focused state modules (imports, commands, registry), centralizes launch token expansion, consolidates cache epochs, upgrades the tools menu with full ARIA keyboard navigation, memoizes search indexing with LRU caching, and hardens CSP and exception handling.

Performance and consolidation release. Optimizes state persistence with dirty tracking and batched writes, speeds up library projections, delta lookups, import scanning, metadata batching, BigBox CoverFlow rendering, and native host startup.

Improves cross-store import consolidation across Steam, Heroic, Lutris, Faugus, and ROM collections, hardens CLI help output and import error handling, and ensures completed job futures are released synchronously.

Parity and reliability release. Adds Proton/Wine prefix management, Faugus launcher scans, Eden Switch emulator support, canonical identity deduplication, Edit Game modal navigation, acronym search matching, capability filter rules, and scoped media cleanup.

Reliability guardrails persist and reconcile active sessions against process cmdlines, make game launch preparation transactional, centralize backup credential redaction, and protect shared media files during cleanup.

Packaging fix release. AppImage and Flatpak now bundle every static module, fixing 404s for util.js, state.js and other chunks that left the top bar unresponsive. Routes now handle future JavaScript chunks without manual table updates.
Build fix ensures AppImage bundling creates parent directories for pkg/parity modules.
Repository layout reorganized: docs moved to docs/, tests to tests/ and parity modules to pkg/parity with shims, plus CI, test runner and token hygiene updates.

Hardening release. Plugins use a bubblewrap sandbox when available, with no network or home-directory access, and skip execution by default when the sandbox cannot be created. The test gate now cleans up nested gamescope process trees.

Backend maintenance splits cloud sync, save and backup restore, launch, settings, metadata, import, archive, webhook, and job logic into focused helpers. Source setup documentation now covers tokenized UI access and explicit environment-file locations.

Security release. Release artifacts now require Ed25519 signatures, the workflow separates build, attestation, and publication permissions, build inputs are pinned, and plugin catalogs and downloaded payloads receive stronger integrity checks.

SteamOS AppImages no longer expose bundled libraries to the host shell, fixing the rl_print_keybinding startup failure. Webhook delivery, backups, archives, native bridge origins, Gameyfin paths, media roots, environment loading, jobs, and event streams now enforce tighter trust and resource boundaries.

Bug-fix release. Cloud sync now merges newer per-field values when local changes win, the last-known-good backup mirrors the latest committed state, and play queue skip flags persist before advancing. Queue paths are probed on the filesystem, and OBS recording status requires a recent recording instead of any running process.

Steam and Lutris Flatpak commands verify the app is installed, IGDB time-to-beat now queries the real game_time_to_beats endpoint, and Gameyfin catalog fetches its provider list once. Ed25519 point decoding rejects malformed encodings, the native bridge quotes dialog paths as JSON strings, and the 7z validator counts a final member even without a trailing separator.

Hardening release. Frontend fixes restore Big Box platform switching and IGDB platform-hinted searches, and a crafted custom-field key can no longer inject HTML into the details pane. The session token is scrubbed from the browser address bar after load, and the server rejects requests without a Host header, tightens its CSP, and carries the same security headers on the SSE stream.

Plugin catalog downloads now require a valid sha256 checksum, plugin subprocess environments are scrubbed of secret variables, and tampered before_launch hooks fall back to the original launch command. AppImage launches on SteamOS route through the fallback ladder with failures written to openbox-launch.log instead of vanishing, dmabuf rendering is off unless explicitly enabled, and the updater verifies an Ed25519 signature when a release publishes one.

Native-first release. OpenBox now opens in a native WebKitGTK window by default, rendering the same library UI as the web app instead of a browser tab or the removed Tk interface. The native host owns server lifecycle, single instance, window geometry, minimize-to-tray, and a fallback to the system-browser app window when WebKitGTK is unavailable.
Batch metadata auto-match binds every unmatched game whose title exactly matches the LaunchBox Games Database in one action, instead of matching one game at a time.
Engineering foundation release: lint, compile, coverage, and version-sync gates, a fixed route error path, and a crash report packager.

Box art keeps its natural aspect ratio in the library grid, Big Box Stage, and CoverFlow views instead of being force-cropped into a single ratio, so games with non-standard artwork such as SNES titles display uncropped. Title-only covers keep the standard portrait box.

Launching a game with no launch command or profile now reports a clear error instead of silently exiting with a failed session. The web UI shows the exit code when a session fails, and the emulator install flow skips re-adding an existing Flathub remote and surfaces the flatpak error when it does fail.

Handheld performance profiles: set a TDP limit per launch profile, applied via ryzenadj when a game launches, with an optional restore limit when the session ends. A new Apply handheld performance limits setting (auto / always / off) decides when limits are used; auto applies only on Steam Deck or Bazzite game mode and battery-powered handhelds.

Backup restore now merges archived settings back into the library instead of a sidecar file the app never reads, refuses to overwrite a newer library unless forced, and re-validates symlink parents during extraction.

Cloud sync propagates deletions and resolves conflicts per game by play timestamp. Save backups resolve relative paths, and plugin updates are atomic with rollback. Emulator scan auto-update configs now run, and storefront launch commands substitute their identifiers.
Big Box exit no longer fires the app-exit commands, plugin library hooks are cached so the UI stays responsive, and the test runner reports per-file results without stopping on the first failure.

The Web UI adds LaunchBox-style advanced search, ordered manual playlists with parent grouping, context actions, Ctrl and Shift multi-selection, configurable status badges, richer collection details, related-game reasons, artwork galleries, and per-game launch profile overrides.

Backup archives can be listed, inspected, and restored from the Web UI. Extended artwork groups cover clear logos, fanart, banners, icons, box backs, box spines, 3D boxes, and title screens. Game metadata now includes controller support, disc count, portable status, and broken-entry flags.

Backend hardening adds schema migrations, stable game identities, recovery and atomic persistence, bounded jobs and I/O, safer archive and restore paths, stricter packaging checks, focused regression tests, and verified Chromium coverage for the new workflows.

Steam Game Mode guest support runs Big Box inside gamescope on Steam Deck and similar handhelds, while Steam keeps Input and Quick Access Menu controls. Settings can now remove all Steam-imported library entries at once without deleting game files or media.

Session playtime and Gameyfin installs track stable library identities after deletes or reorders. Gameyfin downloads stage safely, storefront failures return readable errors, and AppImage launches work through Gear Lever and desktop menus.
Local diagnostic logs record requests, failures, and uncaught crashes with token and password redaction. Metadata artwork downloads now use the active LaunchBox image CDN.

AppImage fix for Gear Lever and desktop-menu launches: bundled library paths no longer break host xdg-open/browsers, the desktop entry uses a unique io.openbox.GameLauncher id, and openbox:// start boots the server when no instance is running.

In case you missed 0.4.8 and 0.4.9: Steam Game Mode guest support (--game-mode Big Box under gamescope on Deck/Bazzite-style sessions), and session/Gameyfin reliability fixes so playtime and installs track the correct library entry.

Reliability release: session and Gameyfin installs update the correct library entry after deletes or reorders, Gameyfin downloads stage safely and stream to disk, Lutris CLI failures return JSON errors, and empty release checksum files are rejected cleanly.

Steam Game Mode guest support for Steam Deck and other handhelds: run OpenBox inside Steam's gamescope session with --game-mode, Big Box opens fullscreen, Steam Input and Quick Access Menu controls stay with Steam, and non-Steam launches get window tags gamescope can track.
AppImage desktop integration launches the bundled application through AppRun.
Reliability release: invalid POST request shapes now return bounded JSON errors, with expanded real-HTTP API boundary regression coverage and refreshed project identity and support documentation.
Parity release: saved filter presets, deep links, granular backups, process tracking, IGDB lookup, YAML emulator definitions, and library UI reliability fixes.
Bug-fix release: settings persistence, API error handling, Gameyfin install recovery, and related reliability fixes.
Bug-fix release: settings partial-POST merge, storefront-only save, GET error JSON responses, Gameyfin install recovery, premium route auth, and session poll guard.
Background Gameyfin installs with status polling and isolated storefront settings fields.
Fixes in-app update checks using GitHub release digests, clearer update errors, and top-bar zoom scaling.
Gameyfin storefront integration with on-demand install and uninstall, owned vs installed library filters, and optional Ludusavi and Hoard save-tool hooks.

Premium parity release with custom fields, ESRB filters, list view, import wizard, bundled media packs, and Big Box updates. LaunchBox Premium-equivalent workflows are included without a subscription.
Storefront catalogs, Big Box updates, integrations, and Linux equivalents for storefront and integration workflows.
